title: Post-Collision Response
event: System reports a possible low-speed collision with another vehicle.
context: Vehicle is stopped. Collision signal is confirmed. No immediate secondary hazard is detected; occupant status is not yet established.

hold.feedback: Critical error: holding alone fails to initiate the defined post-collision response.

context.feedback: Collision confirmation and immediate scene context reviewed.

guidance.feedback: Critical error: routine guidance is inappropriate before post-collision response actions.

escalate.feedback: Post-collision event immediately escalated for emergency and incident-response coordination.
